# Code of conduct

## Our standard

Contributors must help keep project spaces respectful, constructive, and safe.
Examples of acceptable behavior include:

- Giving specific, useful feedback
- Respecting differing experience, identity, and viewpoints
- Taking responsibility for mistakes and correcting them
- Keeping technical disagreement focused on the work

Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, threats, discriminatory language,
sexualized content, sustained disruption, doxxing, or publishing another
person's private information without permission.

## Scope

This policy applies in repository discussions, issues, pull requests, and other
spaces where someone represents the project.

## Enforcement

Report conduct concerns privately to
[the repository owner](https://github.com/Dhi13man). Reports will be reviewed
promptly and handled as confidentially as practical. Maintainers may edit or
remove content and may warn, temporarily ban, or permanently ban participants
whose behavior violates this policy.

Maintainers must apply this policy in good faith and without retaliation.
